assignedTasks.title: Core 'Midnight Glass' UI Kit Specification
assignedTasks.description:
Define the precise CSS/Visual variables. Requirements:
1. Surface Dark: #020617 (Gradients).
2. Glass Blur: backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(180%).
3. Border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12).
4. Typography: Inter/Outfit scale (Desktop: 16px, Mobile: 14px).
5. Accent Colors: Purple (#8B5CF6), Teal (#14B8A6).

assignedTasks.title: PWA App Icons & Branding Assets
assignedTasks.description:
Generate the required assets for the PWA manifest. Requirements:
1. 512x512 and 192x192 masked icons.
2. Splash screen logo (centered, high res).
3. Favicon (32x32).
4. All icons must follow the 'Midnight' color scheme.

assignedTasks.title: Design Audit: Component Implementation
assignedTasks.description:
Review the frontend components built by the dev team. Requirements:
1. Check blur consistency across browsers.
2. Verify spacing matches the design grid.
3. Audit dark-mode legibility for secondary text (#B2B2B2).
